structuredData.headline: Duta Park Warm Contemporary Haven — 2+1 Bedroom Turnkey Fit-Out in Kuala Lumpur
structuredData.description: A 2+1 bedroom, 2 bathroom residence at Duta Park Residences, Jalan Kuching, Kuala Lumpur, fitted out on an RM 43,300 all-inclusive budget. Features fluted oak panelling to the TV wall, living-dining divider and master headboard, a backlit LED feature mirror, double-track curtains with sheers, an L-shaped kitchen with oak and cream cabinetry and quartz stone countertop, two-zone gas hob, frosted glass window, washer dryer, queen divans with pocket-spring mattresses, mirrored wardrobes and a utility room partitioned with an aluminium sliding door.
